links.note: The error to explain is that the constant -2 in H(n) = 5n - 2 is the value at n = 0, not the first tower (H(1) = 3), and part (c) asks why H(0) need not be real. That the constant is the value at zero is the y-intercept concept.

B(x) = ax + 9 is recovered as 5x + 9 from one printed value, then its zero -9/5 is found and interpreted. The object throughout is a degree-1 polynomial and its single zero; the set has no separate zero concept.
